subject: Marketplace concession request - OpenHeart nonprofit pilot
messages:
From: Sara Gomez <sara@openheart.org>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace listing discount for nonprofit pilot

Marcus —

Thanks for the quick connect on Tuesday. OpenHeart is preparing an 18-month pilot to evaluate LLM-driven triage and outreach for our volunteer intake process. We’d like to purchase Redwood via AWS Marketplace so our procurement and grant reporting remains tidy.

Our ask: a significant listing discount for the pilot (we were thinking ~60% off list) and the option to convert to a standard commercial agreement if the pilot meets the KPIs. Budget for the pilot is limited (grant funding), so listing credits would make this feasible.

Key facts:
- Pilot term: 18 months (start Sep 1)
- Expected cloud consumption: ~400k tokens/month initial, ramping to 1.2M tokens/month
- Post-pilot commercial potential: estimated $120k ARR if expanded into casework and outreach
- Procurement contact: procurement@openheart.org

Can you advise what path exists for a nonprofit concession on Marketplace? We need marketplace listing/offer pricing confirmed by mid-August to align with grant timelines.

Appreciate it —
Sara Gomez
Director of Operations
OpenHeart Foundation
[Attachment: OpenHeart_RFP_Summary.pdf (application/pdf)]
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sara Gomez <sara@openheart.org>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing discount for nonprofit pilot

Hi Sara —

Thanks for the detailed note and congrats on securing grant funding. We absolutely support nonprofit pilots and have a few paths we can take (listing concession, channel credit via AWS, or a temporary private offer).

I’m looping in Monica (our Partner Programs lead) who manages Marketplace mechanics. We typically need a quick pricing worksheet and an SOW to evaluate the size of concession and co-sell eligibility. Could you send the SOW and the grant statement of work? I attached a short checklist below of what helps speed approvals.

Needed to expedite:
- Short SOW (objectives, success metrics)
- Expected spend profile by month during pilot
- Confirmation that OpenHeart will accept a Marketplace listing/private-offer flow for procurement

We can get an initial internal opinion same-day once we have the worksheet; final approval will go through Deal Desk. If agreeable, I’ll open a formal escalation (deal DL-9876) to request a marketplace concession and co-sell support.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Strategic Deals Manager | Redwood Inference

--
Checklist: SOW, monthly consumption estimate, procurement contact, grant timeline
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@openheart.org
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Escalation: OpenHeart Foundation - marketplace concession request (DL-9876)

Team —

Escalating a concession request for an NGO pilot that needs marketplace pricing confirmed by mid-August. Summary below and attached pricing worksheet + draft SOW. Internal participants should only be those on this thread.

Customer: OpenHeart Foundation
Deal id: DL-9876 (please attach to HubSpot record)
Pilot: 18 months, expected ramp 400k -> 1.2M tokens/mo
Commercial potential: ~$120k ARR post-pilot
Ask: 60% listing discount on AWS Marketplace offer for pilot; AWS co-sell requested.

Proposal (my recommendation):
- Approve a 40% listing concession on AWS Marketplace for the 12-month first phase, with an option to extend 6 months at 25% if KPIs are met (reduces initial revenue exposure).
- Supplement with AWS channel credit for onboarding (one-time credit up to $15k) if co-sell is enabled.
- Require DocuSign PO signed by procurement and a clause that conversion to commercial contract requires 30 days notice before pilot end.

Rationale: 60% is aggressive given our standard marketplace concession bands. We should balance unit economics with the likelihood of conversion and co-sell coverage. Customer is an NGO but has measurable expansion potential and strong PR value for co-sell motion.

Attachments: pricing-worksheet.xlsx (breaks down per-token revenue vs concession), OpenHeart_Pilot_SOW.pdf
HubSpot: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/DL-9876

Request: Karthik — can Deal Desk approve a 40% listing concession + conditional AWS channel credit for onboarding? If you need a different band, propose alternatives. Timelines: customer needs confirmation by 2027-08-15.

Thanks,
Marcus
Strategic Deals Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@openheart.org
Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2027 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Escalation: OpenHeart Foundation - marketplace concession request (DL-9876)

Marcus / Monica —

Thanks for the clear summary and the worksheet. Reviewed with Finance and Partner Ops. Decision below: we will APPROVE the concession with the following conditions.

Approved concession: 45% listing discount on the AWS Marketplace offer for an initial 12-month pilot term (not 18). A 12-month pilot gives us clearer renewal cadence and reduces forecast variance.

Conditions:
- AWS co-sell must be enabled within 30 days and OpenHeart must be added to our co-sell pipeline (Partner Ops will own).
- One-time onboarding channel credit up to $12,500 (applied as customer-facing credit) contingent on co-sell enablement.
- Pilot must include success metrics and a conversion window; conversion to a commercial contract requires notice 30 days before pilot end.
- Legal to add a clause limiting the concession to the pilot term and protecting our standard SKU price post-conversion.

Next steps (action items):
1) Marcus: get procurement sign-off on the SOW and confirm they accept a Marketplace private offer flow.
2) Monica / Partner Ops: open co-sell intake and assign partner rep.
3) Legal: prepare a short amendment/term sheet (I can loop in legal if needed).
4) Marcus: once conditions are acknowledged, we’ll provide the private-offer config and DocuSign link for signatures (see provisional DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/link/abcdef123456).

Karthik Iyer
Deal Desk Lead | Redwood Inference
